key.name: vpn-directory
key.summary: Directory containing the OpenVPN config (openvpn runs with --cd here)

key.name: vpn-config
key.summary: OpenVPN config file, relative to the VPN directory

key.name: vpn-check-url
key.summary: URL probed while the VPN is connected; any HTTP response means the network behind it is reachable (empty: skip the check)

key.name: kube-start-command
key.summary: Command that starts Kube Monitor (run with bash -lc inside the project directory)

key.name: kube-port
key.summary: Port Kube Monitor listens on (used for status and to stop it)

key.name: kube-app-id
key.summary: Desktop file ID of the Kube Monitor PWA (empty: find the app named “Kube Monitor”, else open the browser)
